items.title: Bitcoin on course to end seven-week losing streak while trailing stock rebound
items.desc: Bitcoin (BTC) has risen 1.8% since midnight UTC to around $61,600 and is on course to end seven straight weekly losses.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin rebounds above $61,000 as AI stocks lead premarket gains

items.title: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin
items.desc: Pablo Hernández de Cos, chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde, favors blockchain-based banking and has warned against private digital currencies and banks holding bitcoin.

items.title: Kalshi Courts Small Businesses With 'Microinsurance' as State Crackdowns Bite
items.desc: Kalshi says about 500 businesses have used it to hedge risks such as tariffs and bad weather, as legal fights weigh on its sports markets.

items.title: Bitcoin supply metric hits 11-year low as new ‘capitulation’ signal arrives

items.title: Injective asks SEC to allow order books for tokenized stock trading
items.desc: The regulator's rules favor one type of blockchain trading system, leaving platforms built on Injective out, the developer said. It wants the SEC to open stock trading to order-book systems.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend

items.desc: Spot bitcoin ETFs have already hit record monthly net outflows of $5.39 billion in November, with several trading days remaining.

items.desc: BIT Asset Management's BBIT fund debuted on SIX Swiss Exchange with 350 BTC in assets and a 0.19% annual expense ratio.

items.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
items.desc: An attacker steered up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power to an impostor pool earlier in November using a weakness most of the industry's largest pools still carry.

items.desc: Galaxy now treats a daily close below $58,525, the June 30 closing low, as the start of a move toward a materially lower low.

items.desc: Sens. Warren and Van Hollen sent two letters to SEC Chair Atkins demanding he rescind the innovation exemption and Regulation Crypto.

items.desc: Braiins says an attacker exploited the unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, striking over 1,000 sites in a single second.
